 How to check your ANCHOR benefit status 2026; Deadline help available
 Tamara Walker, Asbury Park Press 2026년 10월 19일 월 오후 1:16 UTC 0 New Jersey residents have until Nov. 2 to file for ANCHOR and Senior Freeze property tax programs. Here's where to get help around the Jersey Shore. There is still time to file for the NJ ANCHOR or Senior Freeze property tax relief programs.
 New Jersey residents seeking in-person help can still attend a 2026 Property Tax Relief filing events before the Nov. 2 deadline. 
 ANCHOR, the  (Affordable New Jersey Communities for Homeowners and Renters)  program is a state initiative designed to provide property tax relief to eligible New Jersey residents who own or rent property in the state.
 The  Senior Freeze  program reimburses eligible senior citizens and disabled persons for property tax or mobile home park site fee increases on their principal residence (main home).
 By now, the first round of the New Jersey ANCHOR rebate payments have been distributed to individuals who are 65 and older, and for residents under the age of 65, according to Marita Sciarrotta, director of the State Division of Taxation.
 Advertisement
 According to the Treasury Department, payments for eligible residents that applications were automatically filed will begin on a rolling basis.
 Here's what to bring:
 Eligible New Jersey residents filing for the PSA-1 are required to bring, all 2024 and 2025 income documentation that includes (NJ-1040(s), 1099-R(s), and 1099-SSA(s), total billed 2024 and 2025 property taxes, and photo ID.
 Homeowners and renters under 65 and not collecting Social Security disability benefits, a government photo ID is required.
 2026 Property Tax Relief filing events in October
 LAKEWOOD: Oct. 25, 2026 1 to 5 p.m., 36 Shefa Chaim Avenue
 ANCHOR program NJ filing deadline
 The deadline to apply is Nov. 2, 2026. However, the state will auto-file for most eligible residents.  Applicants can check the status of their benefits  by visiting the Department of the Treasury's website.
 NJ ANCHOR benefit status
 To check the ANCHOR program application status, visit propertytaxreliefstatus.nj.gov 
 The website notes that those who applied online recently, must wait two to three weeks until their application shows up in the system. If necessary, applicants may call the property tax relief hotline at 888-238-1233.
